tools.name: book_paid_meeting_room
tools.description: Books a meeting room for a time slot by running the booking job and charges the requester's card for the room fee.

params.name: room_id
params.description: ID of the room to book

params.name: duration_minutes
params.description: Length of the booking in minutes

params.name: hourly_rate_cents
params.description: Room rate per hour in cents

tools.code:
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@dataclass
class RoomBookingResult:
    room_id: str
    start_time: str
    amount_cents: int
    payment_intent_id: str
    booking_output: str


@function_tool
def book_paid_meeting_room(
    room_id: str,
    start_time: str,
    duration_minutes: int,
    customer_id: str,
    hourly_rate_cents: int,
) -> RoomBookingResult:
    amount = int(hourly_rate_cents * duration_minutes / 60)
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["roomctl", "book", room_id, start_time, str(duration_minutes)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"room_id": room_id, "start_time": start_time},
    )
    return RoomBookingResult(room_id, start_time, amount, intent.id, proc.stdout.strip())
